shortDescription: Al Habtoor Group is a prominent UAE conglomerate operating across hospitality, automotive, real estate, education, and publishing.
whatTheyDo: The group develops and operates luxury hotels and mixed-use complexes, distributes automotive brands including Mitsubishi and Bentley through Al Habtoor Motors, and operates schools and vehicle leasing fleets. Its hospitality, commercial, and technical teams manage extensive assets across the UAE.
address: 727 Al Wasl Road, Al Safa 2, P.O. Box 25444, Dubai, UAE

sources.title: UAE Constructors - Al Habtoor Group Company Profile

notes: Headquartered on Al Wasl Road in Al Safa 2, not Downtown Dubai. Not to be confused with Al Hathboor Group, which is a separate UAE corporate entity.

shortDescription: Al Mal Capital PSC is a Dubai-based asset management and financial advisory firm regulated by the UAE Securities and Commodities Authority.
whatTheyDo: The firm provides investment banking, asset management, and direct investment services to institutional and private clients. It serves as the fund manager for the DFM-listed Al Mal Capital REIT and is an 83.95% subsidiary of Dubai Investments PJSC.
address: Office 901, 48 Burj Gate, Downtown Dubai, Sheikh Zayed Road, P.O. Box 119930, Dubai, UAE

sources.title: Dubai Financial Market - Al Mal Capital PSC Profile

notes: Headquartered at 48 Burj Gate in Downtown Dubai, not in the DIFC. It is regulated by the Securities and Commodities Authority (SCA) rather than the DFSA.

shortDescription: Almarai is a multinational food and beverage company that operates extensive cold-chain logistics and commercial distribution networks across the UAE.
whatTheyDo: The company distributes dairy products, fruit juices, bakery goods, and poultry across UAE retail and foodservice channels. Its regional operations manage warehousing, temperature-controlled distribution fleets, and commercial sales teams.
address: Dubai Industrial City, Saih Shuaib 2, Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, Dubai, UAE

sources.title: 2GIS UAE - Almarai Dubai Industrial City Branch

notes: Corporate headquarters is in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia; UAE operations are centered at distribution and logistics facilities in Dubai Industrial City and Al Quoz, not in JLT (Jumeirah Lakes Towers).

shortDescription: Al Masraf (Arab Bank for Investment and Foreign Trade) is a UAE-based financial institution providing corporate, commercial, and retail banking services.
whatTheyDo: The bank offers corporate and commercial financing, trade finance, treasury services, consumer retail banking, and Islamic banking solutions. It operates a branch and ATM network across the Emirates, with major centers in Abu Dhabi and Dubai.
address: Al Masraf Tower, Hamdan Bin Mohammed Street, P.O. Box 46733, Abu Dhabi, UAE

sources.title: Bank-UAE - Al Masraf Information and Directory

notes: Headquartered in Abu Dhabi at Al Masraf Tower on Hamdan Street; its main Dubai facility is Al Masraf Tower on Baniyas Road in Deira. It does not maintain an office or branch in Dubai Internet City.

shortDescription: Al Naboodah Group Enterprises is a major UAE family-owned conglomerate operating in civil engineering, building construction, automotive, and commercial trade.
whatTheyDo: The group delivers civil infrastructure, building, and MEP projects, leases and distributes commercial vehicles and heavy plant equipment, and provides logistics services. Its engineering and technical teams support public and private sector projects across the UAE.
address: Al Awir 800, Dubai - Hatta Road (E44), P.O. Box 80657, Dubai, UAE

sources.title: PitchBook - Al Naboodah Group Enterprises Profile
Dubai OFW - Al Naboodah Careers & Emiratisation

notes: Headquartered in Al Awir / Al Rowaiyah Third along the Dubai-Hatta Road (E44, Makani 50314 83359), not Downtown Dubai. Operates under Saeed Juma Al Naboodah Group following family restructuring; distinct from Khalifa Juma Al Nabooda Group.

shortDescription: Al Rostamani Group is a diversified UAE conglomerate operating across financial exchange, building contracting, automotive, information technology, and travel.
whatTheyDo: The group manages companies across electrical infrastructure engineering, civil contracting, automotive commercial distribution, foreign exchange services, and IT solutions. Its specialized business units deliver projects and services throughout the UAE.
address: The Maze Tower, Sheikh Zayed Road, Trade Centre 1, P.O. Box 29046, Dubai, UAE
notes: Headquartered at the Maze Tower on Sheikh Zayed Road (Trade Centre 1), not in Business Bay. Distinct from AW Rostamani Group (AWR), which is headquartered in Deira.

shortDescription: Al Safi Danone is a regional dairy and beverage producer formed as a joint venture between Saudi Arabia's Al Faisaliah Group and France's Danone.
whatTheyDo: The company produces and distributes fresh milk, laban, yogurt, and dairy desserts across the GCC. In the UAE, it maintains dedicated cold-chain warehousing, transport logistics, and retail distribution teams.
address: Agility Building, 16D Street, Al Quoz Industrial Area 4, Dubai, UAE

sources.title: The National - Nadec and Al Safi Danone call off merger
HiDubai - Al Safi Danone Company Profile

notes: Headquartered in Saudi Arabia as a joint venture between Al Faisaliah Group and Groupe Danone. In Dubai, it operates a sales and distribution facility in Al Quoz Industrial Area 4, not an office in JLT (Jumeirah Lakes Towers). No active standalone corporate website exists.

shortDescription: Alserkal Group is an Emirati family conglomerate founded in 1947, operating across environmental engineering, real estate, and industrial investments.
whatTheyDo: The group develops commercial and residential properties, operates environmental management infrastructure (such as the Alserkal Waste Treatment Plant), and participates in industrial investments. Its technical teams focus on environmental engineering, recycling, and facilities management in Dubai.
address: Office 601, 6th Floor, Alserkal Building, Airport Road, Deira, P.O. Box 21333, Dubai, UAE

sources.title: Gulf News - Thabat Family Business Programme

notes: Headquartered on Airport Road in Deira, Dubai. Directory references to 'DIC' appear to confuse Dubai Internet City with Dubai Industrial City (where the group has operational plants) or relate to tech incubator partnerships. Also distinct from Alserkal Avenue cultural district in Al Quoz.

shortDescription: Alshaya Group is a multinational retail franchise operator managing international retail, culinary, and lifestyle brands across the UAE.
whatTheyDo: The group franchises and operates retail brands including Starbucks, H&M, Shake Shack, and Boots in prime commercial destinations across the UAE. Regional operations manage store development, logistics, inventory supply chains, IT systems, and corporate administrative functions.
address: Al Barsha Boutique Building, Al Barsha 1, 316 Road, P.O. Box 1277, Dubai, UAE
notes: Global headquarters is located in Kuwait. In Dubai, the corporate office is situated in the Al Barsha Boutique Building in Al Barsha 1, not Downtown Dubai (where it operates retail stores in The Dubai Mall).

shortDescription: Albwardy Damen (formerly Albwardy Marine Engineering) is a UAE maritime engineering and shipbuilding company providing vessel construction and marine repair services.
whatTheyDo: The company provides drydocking, marine mechanical and electrical repairs, specialized underwater diving services, and new vessel construction for commercial and naval fleets. Its Dubai operations are based at Dubai Maritime City, with primary shipyard operations located in Hamriyah Free Zone, Sharjah.
address: Dubai Maritime City, P.O. Box 6515, Dubai, UAE
notes: Originally founded as Albwardy Marine Engineering, the company has operated as Albwardy Damen since establishing a joint venture with Damen Shipyards Group. Its Dubai base is in Dubai Maritime City, not Business Bay; primary shipyard facilities are in Hamriyah Free Zone, Sharjah.
